description: Default importance-first lookup from 1-5 importance and urgency scores to P0, P1, P2, or drop, as described in https://john-hodge.com/blog/why-p2-work-rarely-gets-done/. grid[i - 1][u - 1] is the level for importance i and urgency u. Copy this file and pass it with --matrix to use your own anchors or cells.

importance.label: Supports a goal indirectly, or meets an obligation with moderate consequences
Directly advances an annual goal, or prevents serious harm to health, family, or a commitment others depend on

urgency.label: Cost rises within days; this week
Cost rises within hours; start today

P0.name: interrupt
P0.action: Rewrite today's three goals around it, and name the goal it displaces.

P1.name: schedule
P1.action: Give it a slot in one of the next few days' three goals, or do it around today's three if it cannot wait.

P2.name: list
P2.action: Put it on the P2 list and plan as if it will not happen. The periodic review promotes it to P1 or deletes it.

drop.name: drop
drop.action: Decline it or delete it now.
